result.description: Creator-monetization and checkout platform (subscriptions, products, payments) with a public REST API for checkout sessions, subscribers, customers, webhooks and discount codes.
result.auth_detail: Per-creator API key sent in x-api-key header, scoped by area (checkout-sessions, payments/transactions, webhooks, customers). Base URL https://www.fanbasis.com/public-api/. No OAuth found. Source is search snippets of the FanBasis GitHub repo and a third-party mirror. Page fetches failed, so unverified.
result.access_detail: UNVERIFIED. Per-account keys that each creator generates appear to be the gate, so there is no app review or partner program. A key from one creator cannot touch another creator's sessions. I could not read the pricing page (403) or the dashboard docs, so I could not rule out a paid-plan requirement or find the key-creation steps. Gate-audit questions (1) and (2) are only partly answered: nothing found suggests review or ISV status, and no paid-plan statement was found.
result.api_notes: Per snippets: checkout sessions (create/get/delete, embedded checkout), subscribers, subscriptions, customers, discount codes, products, transactions, refunds, disputes, webhooks (subscription and payment events). Official @fanbasis/checkout-sdk (TypeScript) with sandbox and production environments. Endpoint count unverified.
result.blocker: Official docs and pricing could not be fetched (403/404), so plan gating and key-creation steps are unconfirmed. The only MCP is Zapier's generic one, not vendor-official.
